We need to keep within budget. $10,400 for 3 people for 7 days includes flights, accommodation, meals, attractions. Approx $10,400 / 3 = $3466 per person. Reasonable.

We need to produce plan but not ask follow-ups. So we just output calls to submit_day_plan for each day. Must include fields: day, current_city, transportation, breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation.

Day 2: March 19: Miami. Include attractions: South Beach, Art Deco, Little Havana. Meals: Breakfast at hotel, lunch at local spot, dinner at a party-friendly restaurant. Accommodation same.

Then current_city for travel day maybe "from Miami to Orlando". We'll treat day 3 as travel in evening, but still in Miami for day. Could split but spec wants one entry per day. Day 4: March 21: Orlando. Attractions: Disney World (maybe Magic Kingdom), or Universal Studios. Meals, accommodation.

Day 6: March 23: Travel to Tampa. Attractions: Busch Gardens, Riverwalk. Accommodation.

Day 7: March 24: Tampa, then travel back to Newark? Could be travel back. So day 7: travel from Tampa to Newark. Include transportation flight.

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"
